description: Red de WiFi público de Figueres is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by google.com. Figueres public WiFi network is a data set that is presented in the form of an interactive Google Maps viewer that shows the network of WiFi nodes and the location and name of the municipality's free WiFi points. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Figueres public WiFi network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Red de nodos, Punts WiFi, Figueres, Node Network, Xarxa de nodes, Wi-Fi points. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
